disclosure: Development reuse. Policies set after historical Price results were examined; no blind preregistration or threshold fitting.

exclusions.reason: Previously declared replicon/protein mismatch; no predictor-scored protein.

policy.calls: Integrated scores >= 0.5 are a fixed diagnostic, not a calibrated operating point. No thresholded raw-score claims.
policy.interpretation: Reference agreement, not enzyme detection or experimentally established correctness of every nonmatching call.
policy.population: All declared reference proteins, including proteins with no candidates. Other proteins have no accuracy labels.
policy.projection: Single-destination transfers only; retain unresolved original IDs; deduplicate references and take maximum candidate score.
policy.ranking: All emitted four-level EC IDs, including preliminary IDs. Primary top-1 gives the fraction of top-tied IDs that match the reference; report worst/best tie bounds. Lexical ranks/top-k/MRR are explicitly supplementary.
